Luca Moretti: Hey everyone — I'm Luca, just started today on infra eng! Mostly remote from Turin but in SF next week. Quick non-work question: what's the office coffee situation and any desk-plant swap rules? Poll: reply with :coffee: for 'coffee machine', :kettle: for 'I bring my own', :tea: for 'tea person', or :cactus: for 'no plants'. Thanks! :wave:
zoe martinez: Welcome Luca! Coffee machine in kitchen is 🙏 and we have a little plant shelf by the window — people leave cuttings sometimes. :seedling:
cassidy rambo: hi hi welcome! we do a weekly 'bring-a-bake' on Fridays, also we have a spare mug rack. FYI, don't leave succulents near the AC vents, they get sad.
hr-bot: Welcome to Redwood, Luca! Your badge should be active tomorrow. If you need anything, ping #help or email hr@redwood.com
mira chen: welcome!! i'm usually in Wed/Thu — bring you a coffee when you're in SF? :coffee:
sam pizza: Welcome Luca. If you'd like, I can show you the espresso hack (totally unofficial). :smirk:
Luca Moretti: Love the tips — thanks all! I'm :coffee: and :seedling: — bringing a tiny lemon thyme plant soon. See y'all in SF next week. :nerd_face:
zoe martinez: lemon thyme = amazing. also FYI the plant swap box lives in the supply closet next to the fridge. :tada:
cassidy rambo: also quick poll result: three :coffee:, one :tea:, two :kettle:, one :cactus:. ily plant people. :raised_hands:
